values.note: Standard non-electric site $20, premium non-electric $24, standard electric $29, full hook-up site $40; walk-to tent sites $20-24, cabins $120-130. The same in recreation.gov's 2024-2028 Peak Season tables. A third vehicle on a site is $5 a day.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232088/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-03 to 2026-10-25: 'Standard nonelectric' $20, 'Premium Site' $24, 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' $29, 'FHU Site' $40; templates named 'junk' ignored) + notices ('2 vehicle limit per site'), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 232088 (18 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list 50-amp; 8 of them, e.g. 015, 018, 021, 036-039, 016A, list water and sewer hookups) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232088 ('Sites with electricity, water and sewage hookups are also available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 48 bookable RV/trailer sites (29 standard non-electric, 19 standard electric, 8 of those full hook-up) besides 10 walk-to tent sites and 3 cabins; the description says 65 reservable campsites. Max vehicle lengths run 20-60 ft, mostly 30-45; every site is back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 232088 (site types, equipment, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; MANAGEMENT sites excluded), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232088 (Facilities: 'Hot showers, vault and flush toilets, drinking water, and a dump station are provided'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov rules: 2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on holiday weekends; 14 consecutive nights, and 14 in any rolling 30 days. Check-in 2 PM, campsite check-out noon; fees are paid by 2 PM to the campground hosts.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232088 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 per Rolling 30 Days; notices on check-in/out), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes are accepted and discount the campsite, not utilities; not valid for cabins. The pass holder must occupy the site.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232088 (notice: 'Interagency Senior and Access passes are accepted at most sites ... The pass only allows a discount on the campsite, not utilities. Pass can not be used for cabins.'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $20 base, 50-amp with water+sewer (8 full-hookup sites), reservable on rec.gov, Senior/Access discount (campsite only). Changed fees high 39 -> 40 (the $39 template is named 'junk'; the FHU Site rate is $40). Added 48 back-in RV sites to 60 ft, showers/flush+vault toilets/water/dump, weekend 2- and holiday 3-night minimums, 14-night max. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only), booking window. rec.gov's 'Some sites are waterfront' agrees with the --AWH note and the riverfront call.
